source.description: Reviewed handmade raster 3x2 marker-process contact sheet cropped only after full-sheet approval.
source.notes: One front-facing school backpack with an apple keychain; no lettering, arrows, fake UI, signatures, or watermarks. The first 2026-08-26 sheet was retained privately as rejected-front-loaded-v1 because its early panels previewed too much finished structure.

process_strategy: Six cumulative panels move from sparse placement primitives to the bag silhouette, flap and straps, pocket and apple keychain, marker outlines with every color region, then finishing-only fills and accents.

progression_contract.blank_page_test: A beginner can copy Panel 1 in under two minutes using one tall rounded rectangle, one centerline, two strap routes, a pocket box, an apple circle, and a short shadow route.

final_elements.name: backpack body
final_elements.description: One upright rounded school backpack with a top handle and a simple front-facing silhouette.

final_elements.name: shoulder straps and flap
final_elements.description: Exactly two curved shoulder straps behind the bag plus one rounded top flap.

final_elements.name: front pocket and zipper
final_elements.description: One rounded front pocket with one curved zipper seam and a short pull.

final_elements.name: apple keychain
final_elements.description: One small apple with one leaf hanging from the bag's right zipper pull.

final_elements.name: highlights and ground shadow
final_elements.description: Two open-paper body highlights and one short broken navy ground shadow.

final_elements.name: marker palette
final_elements.description: Black keeper outlines plus coral bag, yellow flap, teal pocket, red apple, green leaf, and navy shadow color regions.

overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: The body centerline and future flap route leave the pocket box open so no keeper contour runs through it.
The zipper-pull tick and apple circle are reserved on the bag's right side before the pocket seam is drawn.

frames.visible_job: Place one tall rounded-rectangle envelope, one centerline, two curved strap routes, one pocket box, one small apple circle with a leaf tick, two white-space ticks, and one short dashed baseline route.
construction_primitives: one apple circle with leaf tick
adds: strap and pocket placement without closed contours
apple placement without an apple contour
must_not_show: black marker outlines or marker color

frames.visible_job: Connect only the upright rounded bag silhouette and short top handle over the pale construction while leaving straps, flap, pocket, and apple open.
Draw exactly two curved shoulder straps behind the bag and one rounded top flap on the established routes, keeping the pocket and apple open.
Draw one rounded front pocket, one curved zipper seam with short pull, one apple with one leaf on the pull, two open highlight reserves, and one broken shadow route.
adds: two highlight reserves and shadow route
must_not_show: new books, pencils, face, or lettering

frames.visible_job: Ink only established contours, then place visible coral, yellow, teal, red, green, and navy marker strokes in every major planned region without completing the fills.
adds: one thick imperfect black keeper-line pass
visible color in every planned region
must_not_show: new books, pencils, face, or lettering

final_step.visible_job: Only complete the established marker fills, strengthen selected keeper contours, and add small highlight and shadow accents.

rejection_checks: Panel 1 must remain under 30 percent structural completion and show no closed bag, strap, flap, pocket, apple, ink, or color.
Exactly two straps, one pocket, one apple, and one leaf must persist once established.
Every major color region must be visible in Panel 5 before the final.
Reject any new book, pencil, face, lettering, vector-like finish, or non-cumulative redraw.
